data_testid_preservation.rule: CRITICAL: All existing data-testids MUST be strictly preserved across App.js, VaultItems.js, SettingsPanel.js, LandingPage.js, and LoadingScreen.js to ensure zero testing regression.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply gold CSS variables (--gold-primary: #E5B842, --gold-glow: rgba(229,184,66,0.25)) alongside existing navy/cyan tokens.
Upgrade font imports in index.html / App.css to include 'Outfit' or 'Clash Display' for headings, while retaining 'DM Mono' for telemetry and 'Manrope' for body.
Enhance LoadingScreen.js with a cinematic HUD ring and gold shimmer.
Style Vault dashboard with crisp 1px borders, subtle gold glows on primary CTAs, and telemetry metric cards.
Maintain complete dark/light theme switching capability using CSS custom properties.
Ensure all interactive components retain exact data-testid attributes.
